name: P ZERO Race RS (tube type)

origin.basis: Italian tire maker; Pirelli says the P ZERO Race range is made at its plant in Italy near its Milan headquarters.

manufacturing.basis: Pirelli: the P ZERO Race RS is made in Italy.

positioning: Tube-type version of Pirelli's top P ZERO Race RS.
pressure_note: The product page gives no maximum pressure; use the figure printed on the tire.

wet_notes.summary: Pirelli claims improved grip, especially on wet surfaces.

availability.note: Listed in Pirelli's UK catalogue with a dealer finder; P ZERO tires are sold by retail shops on Taobao and Tmall in mainland China; North American availability not verified.

caveats: Lab results for this exact version were not read.
